**1. Scene:** A meal of sliced breaded chicken, yellow rice, leafy salad, broccoli and a round of corn on the cob.

**2. Vessel:** A rounded-square dinner plate, approximately 26 cm across. Using a circular approximation, its area is **3.14 × 13² ≈ 531 cm²**. The food on the plate at the left edge is excluded.

**3. Items:** Breaded chicken, seasoned yellow rice, spinach leaves, broccoli and corn. No separate sauce or dressing is clearly visible; any cooking fat is included in the chicken and rice energy estimates.

**4–7. Area, volume, weight and energy:** Areas represent approximate non-overlapping shares of the plate. Corn weight estimates the edible kernels, not the cob.

| Item | Plate area | Area × height = gross volume | Bulk density | Estimated grams | kcal/100 g | Energy |
|---|---:|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Breaded chicken slices | 17% | 90 × 1.5 = 135 ml | 0.95 | 128 g | 230 | 294 kcal |
| Yellow rice | 15% | 80 × 1.5 = 120 ml | 0.8 | 96 g | 150 | 144 kcal |
| Spinach leaves | 30% | 159 × 2.7 = 429 ml | 0.15 | 64 g | 23 | 15 kcal |
| Corn kernels on cob | 6% | 32 × 1.7 = 54 ml | 0.65 | 35 g | 96 | 34 kcal |
| Broccoli | 3% | 16 × 2 = 32 ml | 0.6 | 19 g | 35 | 7 kcal |

**8. Sanity check:** The allocated areas total **71%**, consistent with the substantial empty space on the plate. The leaves occupy considerable space but weigh little, while the chicken and rice provide most of the weight and energy. Estimated edible total: **342 g and 494 kcal**. The breading and cooking method are the main sources of uncertainty.
